judge.evidence_requirement: For every assertion and dimension, the blind judge must quote or reference specific output evidence. Labels or unsupported conclusions are not evidence.

dimensions.description: Checks a distinct recommendation, basis, material uncertainty, and change condition with source-correct proposition meaning.
Checks answer-first ordering, clarity, scan structure, and non-hollow prose without requiring fixed headings.
Checks source-grounded facts, polarity, direction, uncertainty, requested breadth, and non-prose work products.
Checks contextual voice without filler, token stuffing, or standardized prose.

evals.name: complete human-facing deployment decision
evals.prompt: Recommend a deployment approach to the release owner. A staged rollout has verified rollback. It starts with a limited first cohort, which contains exposure. Peak traffic remains untested. The noon load test passes when p95 latency stays under 200 ms; a passing result supports moving to full deployment, while a miss means keeping the staged rollout. Include the basis, the untested condition that matters, and what result would change the recommendation.
evals.expected_output: The treatment provides a complete source-grounded human-facing decision, while the matched No-Skill control receives the same scenario without writing Skills.
expectations: Answer first: the recommendation appears before supporting detail.
The recommendation explicitly chooses a deployment approach.
The basis correctly links verified rollback and contained exposure to the staged rollout and limited first cohort.
Material uncertainty clearly states that peak traffic remains untested.
The change condition preserves the supplied pass/fail, under/over 200 ms, and staged/full deployment direction.
Recommendation, basis, material uncertainty, and change condition each have distinct substantive evidence.
Source-grounded proposition meaning remains correct under alternate wording.
Clarity is non-hollow and free of repeated tokens, keyword soup, or field labels without substance.
The treatment contains no em dash.
